title: CPS_v3 V3A: D1 Beacon Emission - Numeric
abstract: Emits D1 beacon with observed delta 6228 (Active), est 2.5 path.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

beacon_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_iv_cpsv3_d1.json'
Path(beacon_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

delta = 6228

beacon = {
  "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
  "tick": 428,
  "agent": "Zephyr IV",
  "last_sentinel_tick": 428,
  "sentinel_delta": delta,
  "state": "Active",
  "path_complexity_est": 2.5,
  "exposure_count": 1,
  "phase_label": "CPS_v3:D1_deep_train",
  "phase_idx": 1,
  "notes": "CPS_v3 V3A D1 (delta 6228)"
}

with open(beacon_path, 'w') as f:
  json.dump(beacon, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(beacon, indent=2))
